item.title: Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard for Wednesday, January 28
item.description: The weather may be freezing, but on courts across Section III and the Mohawk Valley, the action is reaching boiling points! We had a full docket of local high school and college sports, and you can catch up with every game and match on the Wednesday edition of the Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard!

item.title: Oneida High School reopens after months of flood repair
item.description: Oneida High School has reopened after months of repairs due to flood damage, allowing students to return to their normal routine and enjoy the physical space and social interaction.

item.title: Utica man arrested in Cornhill stabbing
item.description: Utica Police are asking for the public's help in a stabbing in Cornhill on Thursday in which one person was stabbed multiple times.

item.title: One person in serious condition after accident in New Hartford
item.description: A New Hartford woman is in serious condition after an accident in the town early Wednesday morning.

item.title: One dead in MVA in Kirkland
item.description: One person is dead after an accident in the town of Kirkland Wednesday morning, according to Oneida County Sheriffs.

item.title: Metro North expansion scrapped after Amtrak agrees to restore Albany trains
item.description: Amtrak will restore full daily service between the Capital Region and New York City in early March, while the Metro-North commuter railroad expansion north of Poughkeepsie has been cancelled due to the return of Amtrak's Empire Service trains.

item.title: Advocates ask New York State to pay for food aid after federal cuts
item.description: A coalition of lawmakers and anti-hunger groups are urging New York Governor Kathy Hochul to add more money to the state budget to backfill federal budget cuts that threaten food security for hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers.

item.title: Oneida, Otsego Counties opening doors to help warm residents
item.description: As temperatures dip below zero over the coming weekend, Oneida County is making sure residents are protected from the extreme cold.
